field_principles.field_principles: Explains why every Exp5764 field exists before downstream allocation or timing work can consume the artifact.
field_principles.status: Bare terminal state lets gates distinguish complete from blocked without parsing prose.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records provenance, build, host-stability, resource, and Exp5751 replay gates before profiling starts.
field_principles.spec_refs: Binds the artifact to REQ-SAMPLE-5764 and SCENARIO-SAMPLE-5764.
field_principles.upstream_artifact_hashes: Pins Exp5751, Exp5758, and Exp5739 evidence so parity and prior timing context cannot drift.
field_principles.source_hashes_before: Hashes the source bytes that were profiled before the compact hot-path edit.
field_principles.source_hashes_after: Hashes the source bytes after optimization so reviewers can separate measured before/after code.
field_principles.rust_toolchain: Records rustc and cargo versions used for release PyO3 profiling.
field_principles.python_version: Records the CPython runtime used for SamplerBackend execution.
field_principles.pyo3_version: Records the binding dependency version relevant to PyO3 boundary allocation.
field_principles.host_receipts: Authenticates CPU, governor, memory, disk, thread, and competing-process observations.
field_principles.release_build_receipt: Shows the release PyO3 build command and exit code.
field_principles.affinity_receipt: Records fixed CPU placement used for profiling and parity replay.
field_principles.phase_definitions: Defines every measured phase before selecting a dominant phase.
field_principles.phase_timing_receipts: Preserves raw warm and restart-containing phase samples by size.
field_principles.phase_share_by_size: Shows median phase share and confidence interval for each measured size.
field_principles.dominant_phase: Names the preregistered dominant end-to-end phase selected from phase-share evidence.
field_principles.dominant_phase_selection_receipt: Explains why only the selected measured phase was optimized.
field_principles.allocation_counts_before: Reports pre-optimization allocation boundaries rather than inferring them from time.
field_principles.allocation_counts_after: Reports post-optimization allocation boundaries and any unavoidable remaining allocation.
field_principles.buffer_reuse_receipts: Proves the compact path uses contiguous reused work buffers instead of per-sample heap buffers.
field_principles.worker_pool_receipts: Documents fixed worker policy and that no dynamic per-sample worker scheduling is introduced.
field_principles.changed_files: Lists the exact spec, implementation, test, and artifact files changed.
field_principles.checkpoint_compatibility: Proves compact execution preserves the v1 checkpoint schema and restartable state.
field_principles.restart_parity_receipts: Proves optimized checkpoints resume with the same samples and suffix hashes.
field_principles.fallback_equivalence_receipts: Proves exact Python fallback remains equivalent for the profiled cells.
field_principles.semantic_parity_score: Bare scalar equals 1.0 only when semantic, scheduler, RNG, checkpoint, restart, fallback, and sample-count checks pass.
field_principles.distributional_parity_score: Bare scalar equals 1.0 only when matched distribution diagnostics pass across the required seeds and cells.
field_principles.production_backend_reachable_score: Bare scalar equals 1.0 only when the existing explicit one_axis_rust production entrypoint reaches the optimized path.
field_principles.producer_gate_fields: Lists the bare scalar downstream gates without wrapping their values in objects.
field_principles.optimized_path_ready_score: Bare scalar equals 1.0 only when profiling, allocation, buffer reuse, parity, and no-speed gates all pass.
field_principles.timing_promotion_claimed: Bare false prevents profiling from becoming a speed promotion.
field_principles.hardware_speedup_claimed: Bare false prevents local CPU profiling from becoming an accelerator or board claim.
field_principles.two_axis_exchange_reopened: Bare false keeps retired two-axis exchange out of scope.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares local Rust/PyO3 CPU release profiling and parity, not LLM inference or accelerator timing.
field_principles.random_seeds: Records replay seeds for profiling, restart, fallback, and distributional diagnostics.
field_principles.test_commands: Lists the commands used to verify the implementation and artifact.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the complete artifact after blanking the self-checksum field.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Starts complete: or blocked: and states whether the profiled allocation-free hot path is ready.

phase_definitions.python_preparation: NumPy dtype and contiguity preparation before the backend boundary.
phase_definitions.pyo3_crossing: Rust config/core construction and PyO3 argument crossing.
phase_definitions.rust_batch_allocation: One-time Rust compact-run output and workspace allocation.
phase_definitions.worker_scheduling: Fixed single-worker scheduling receipt; no dynamic per-sample worker spawn.
phase_definitions.within_swap_kernel_work: Corrected within-replica and adjacent-label swap sweeps.
phase_definitions.validation: Shape, active-backend, checksum, and receipt validation.
phase_definitions.result_conversion: Diagnostic result materialization and conversion crossing the PyO3 boundary.
